statement_nl: Assume d > 0. There exist homogeneous polynomials f_1, ..., f_d in S = Q[x_1, ..., x_d] graded by deg(x_i)=B+i such that deg(f_i)=A+i for every i, and for each i the image of f_i in S/(f_1, ..., f_{i-1}) is not a zero-divisor. Moreover Hilb_{S/(f_1,...,f_d)}(q)=Q_{A,B,d}(q), so Q_{A,B,d}(q) is realized by a homogeneous regular sequence in the weighted polynomial ring with variable weights B+1, ..., B+d and relation degrees A+1, ..., A+d.
